notes.note: Reviewed the recorded MCP connection/authority and package-boundary claims against the raw-message refusal gate. Only elicitation/create requests and input_required elicitation results with an own __proto__ schema property are refused before SDK normalization; normal traffic still follows the same client codec, turn route, OAuth provider and transport retirement. Legacy replies use the actual request id; modern refusals settle the owning client call. Four real-stdio regression cases fail before the gate and pass afterward in both eras; no MCP Apps rendering, live provider or native/platform claim is upgraded.

Reviewed the recorded contract/package ownership claims against retaining the already published MCP elicitation DTO/export beside the additive input-request/v1 types. This preserves source consumers of the legacy form-only helper; it introduces no second validator, authority token or task-room behavior. Legacy stored MCP forms delegate to the canonical strict input-request reader. Contracts remain browser-neutral types, while validation stays in Shared; existing task and response/event binding descriptions remain accurate.
